terms.title: Terms of Purchase
terms.metaDesc: General terms and conditions for orders placed in the Siwar online store.
terms.sec1_p1: These Terms of Purchase apply to all orders placed in the Siwar webstore. Contracts are concluded between the consumer and Siwar Butik AB, Halmstad, Sweden.
terms.sec1_p2: To complete a purchase, you must be at least 18 years of age or have parental consent.
terms.sec2_p1: All consumer prices are displayed inclusive of Swedish VAT (moms) in compliance with the Swedish Price Information Act. VAT is itemized at 12% for food and pantry items, and 25% for non-food merchandise and shipping fees.
terms.sec2_p2: Siwar sets fixed catalog prices independently in SEK, EUR, and USD without dynamic checkout conversions. Orders are settled in the customer's selected store currency.
terms.sec3_p1: An automated confirmation is dispatched to your email immediately upon ordering. Because Siwar operates a physical retail store, automated safety buffers isolate shelf stock from online overselling. In the rare event of an inventory discrepancy during packing, staff will contact you promptly to substitute or refund the missing item.
terms.sec4_pickup_desc: Free of charge. Orders are prepared and ready for collection at our Halmstad store within 2 business hours.
terms.sec4_delivery_desc: Delivered via PostNord (normally 1–3 business days). Shipping fees are based on gross packaging weight and include 25% VAT.
terms.sec5_p1: Under the Swedish Distance Contracts Act (2005:59), consumers generally have a 14-day statutory right of withdrawal.
terms.sec5_highlight: Please note that fresh food, opened pantry goods, and perishable items are legally exempt from the right of withdrawal.
terms.sec5_link_prefix: For complete legal details and conditions, see our dedicated
terms.sec5_link_text: Right of Withdrawal & Food Exemption Policy
terms.sec6_p1: If an item is damaged or defective upon arrival, notify customer support within a reasonable time with photographic documentation and your order number for a replacement or prompt refund.

withdrawal.title: Right of Withdrawal & Food Exemption
withdrawal.metaDesc: Information regarding consumer withdrawal rights and statutory food exemptions under Swedish law.
withdrawal.subtitle: Your statutory consumer rights and specific exemptions governing food and perishable items.
withdrawal.sec1_p1: For online purchases, consumers have a statutory right to withdraw from the contract within 14 days from the date physical possession of the items is received.
withdrawal.sec1_p2: This right applies strictly to non-food merchandise (e.g., kitchenware, teapots, serving trays, incense burners) provided items are returned unused in original packaging.
withdrawal.sec2_intro: According to Chapter 2, Section 11 of the Swedish Distance Contracts Act, the right of withdrawal does NOT apply to contracts concerning:
withdrawal.sec2_exemption1_tag: Item 4 – Goods subject to rapid deterioration
withdrawal.sec2_exemption1_quote: Goods that can deteriorate quickly or have a short expiration date.
withdrawal.sec2_exemption1_desc: Covers fresh groceries, dairy, pastries, dates, bread, and foods with limited shelf life.
withdrawal.sec2_exemption2_quote: Sealed goods that are not suitable for return due to health protection or hygiene reasons once unsealed by the consumer.
withdrawal.sec2_exemption2_desc: Covers opened jars of spices, olive oils, tahini, canned products, and dry pantry staples once the seal is broken.
withdrawal.sec2_conclusion: By completing checkout, you acknowledge that food products and opened consumables are non-returnable under these statutory exceptions.
withdrawal.sec3_step1: Send written notice within 14 days of delivery to order{'@'}siwar.se with your order number and the product you wish to return.
withdrawal.sec3_step2: You may also utilize the standard withdrawal template provided by Konsumentverket (Swedish Consumer Agency).
withdrawal.sec3_step3: Ship the goods back within 14 days of your notification. In accordance with law, return shipping costs are paid by the consumer.
withdrawal.sec4_p1: Upon inspecting eligible non-food returns, refunds are issued within 14 days to the original payment method used during checkout.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy & GDPR
privacy.metaDesc: Information on how Siwar Butik AB processes personal data under the EU GDPR regulation.
privacy.sec1_p1: Siwar Butik AB, Storgatan 12, 302 43 Halmstad, Sweden, corporate registration number 559123-4567, is the data controller for the processing of your personal data.
privacy.sec1_p2: We respect your personal privacy and are committed to ensuring high data protection standards in full compliance with the EU GDPR.
privacy.sec2_p1: We collect information you provide directly when placing an order or communicating with customer service:
privacy.sec2_item1: Full name, shipping address, and billing details
privacy.sec2_item2: Contact details (email address and mobile phone number for parcel tracking)
privacy.sec2_item3: Order details (purchased items, order reference numbers, selected currency, and payment identifiers)
privacy.sec3_p1: We process your data to fulfill our sales contract with you, deliver ordered products, and provide customer support.
privacy.sec3_p2: Certain processing is required to comply with statutory accounting laws (Bokföringslagen 1999:1078), requiring financial invoice records to be retained for seven years.
privacy.sec4_p1: We never sell your personal data. We only share data with essential, trusted processors required for our operations:
privacy.sec4_item1: Logistics and shipping carriers (e.g., PostNord) to deliver your parcel.
privacy.sec4_item2: Payment service providers (e.g., Swish and card processors) for secure checkout authorization.
privacy.sec5_p1: Under GDPR, you have the right to request a register extract of your personal data free of charge, request rectification of inaccurate data, and under certain circumstances request erasure or restriction of processing.
privacy.sec5_p2: To exercise your rights, contact us at order{'@'}siwar.se. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Swedish Data Protection Authority (Integritetsskyddsmyndigheten, IMY).
